summary: Quota drawer, usage-meter tables and the Usage page replace native hover titles with one React Aria tooltip per clipped value. Account captions, compact meters, resets, amounts, status, the shortcut footer, abbreviated column headers (Usage, $ / tok, +N and the narrow meter's Δ) and the Usage page's status, unit note, series, drill, breakdown and cost labels open the full text on hover and on keyboard focus, and screen readers read the same full text. Meter-history bars are keyboard-focusable with Arrow, Home and End and show their period reading on hover or focus. In narrow usage-meter tables, readings show as a percentage, an alert glyph or a dash, and resets show the row's short form, so neither is cut. A drawer account's provider suffix now folds whole into its tooltip instead of being cut mid-word, and the drawer shortcut footer stays on one line. At narrow drawer widths the sort controls stay 8px apart and keep their labels; inactive sort glyphs hide first. Usage-meter Sort and +N buttons are named from their visible text, and an optional landmarkContext keeps region names unique when several monitors share a page.

schema.detail: No persisted or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Callbacks and data-quota/data-usage-meter row hooks are unchanged; UsageMeterTable, UsageMeterRowDetail and UsageMeterHistoryChart gain an optional landmarkContext prop, and UsageMeterRow gains an optional compactReset (≤4ch) shown below 40rem. Below 40rem the full [data-usage-meter-reading] text is display:none and [data-usage-meter-compact-reading] shows instead; the full reading stays in the cell's [data-usage-meter-full-value]. Clipped cells and Usage page labels no longer carry a title attribute; tests or scripts that read full values from title should read the trigger's [data-quota-full-value] or [data-usage-meter-full-value] text, or the VisuallyHidden copy inside the Usage page triggers. The usage-meter sort button no longer has aria-label 'Cycle usage sort' (select it by [data-usage-meter-cycle-sort]; its name is 'Cycle usage Sort'), and the +N button is named '+N more: show all windows and evidence for <row>' (select it by [data-usage-meter-more]). Hosts must keep rendering the tables inside a ThemePortal so tooltips inherit theme tokens.
